title: Lesson 85 · Never too old to learn
titleZh: 第85课 活到老学到老

examples.en: I have just received a letter from my old school.
examples.zh: 我刚收到母校的一封信。

examples.en: The letter informed me that he would retire.
Mr. Page is our former headmaster.
examples.zh: 佩奇先生是我们的老校长。

examples.en: Pupils of the school will send him a present.
examples.zh: 学校的学生们将送他一份礼物。

examples.en: The gift will mark the occasion.
examples.zh: 这份礼物将用来纪念这一时刻。

examples.en: We are sending him a present to mark the occasion.
examples.zh: 我们送他礼物来纪念这一时刻。

examples.en: Many pupils have contributed towards the gift.
examples.zh: 许多学生为这份礼物捐了钱。

examples.en: The gift will be sent to the headmaster's home.
examples.zh: 礼物将被送到校长家里。

examples.en: They signed their names in a large album.
examples.zh: 他们在一本大签名簿上签了名。

examples.en: We shall remember Mr. Page for his patience.
examples.zh: 我们将铭记佩奇先生的耐心。
他给了我们亲切的鼓励。

examples.en: A farewell dinner will be held next Thursday.
examples.zh: 下星期四将举行告别宴会。

examples.en: The dinner will be held in his honour.
examples.zh: 宴会是为向他表示敬意而举行的。

examples.en: It is a curious coincidence that he retires after forty years.
examples.zh: 他在从教四十年后退休，真是个奇妙的巧合。

examples.en: He has been teaching for a total of forty years.
examples.zh: 他教书的时间总共已达四十年。

examples.en: He will devote himself to gardening.
Gardening will be his new hobby.

sentences.en: I have just received a letter from my old school.
sentences.zh: 我刚收到母校的一封信。

sentences.en: My former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
sentences.zh: 我的老校长斯图亚特·佩奇先生下星期就要退休了。

sentences.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and for his kindly encouragement.
sentences.zh: 我们都将铭记佩奇先生的耐心和他亲切的鼓励。

sentences.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
sentences.zh: 下星期四，许多老校友将出席为他举行的告别宴会。

sentences.en: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
sentences.zh: 但这无关紧要，因为正如他常说的那样，一个人活到老学到老。

article.en: I have just received a letter from my old school.
article.zh: 我刚收到母校的一封信。

article.en: My former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
article.zh: 我的老校长斯图亚特·佩奇先生下星期就要退休了。

article.en: Pupils of the school, old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
article.zh: 学校的师生将送他一份礼物，以纪念这一时刻。

article.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album.
article.zh: 所有为礼物捐款的人都将在一本大签名簿上签名。

article.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and for his kindly encouragement.
article.zh: 我们都将铭记佩奇先生的耐心和他亲切的鼓励。

article.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
article.zh: 下星期四，许多老校友将出席为他举行的告别宴会。

article.en: It is a curious coincidence that Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years when he retires.
article.zh: 真是奇妙的巧合：佩奇先生退休时，他的教书生涯将整整满四十年。

article.en: After he has retired, he will devote himself to gardening, which will be an entirely new hobby for him.
article.zh: 退休后，他将致力于园艺，这对他来说将是一项全新的爱好。

article.en: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
article.zh: 但这无关紧要，因为正如他常说的那样，一个人活到老学到老。
